questions.q: The concept of Pedagogical Content Knowledge (PCK) was introduced by
questions.e: Lee Shulman introduced PCK in the mid-1980s to describe the blend of subject knowledge and pedagogy that is special to teachers.

questions.q: Teaching a theme by drawing on concepts and methods of two or more subjects together is called an ______ approach.
questions.e: An interdisciplinary approach integrates ideas from different disciplines around a theme or problem.

questions.q: A subject that all students must study irrespective of their interests is called a ______ subject.
questions.e: Core subjects are compulsory for all learners. Electives are chosen by students according to interest.

questions.q: Which of the following best describes an academic discipline?
o: A branch of knowledge with its own concepts, methods and standards of inquiry
questions.e: A discipline is an organised body of knowledge with characteristic concepts and ways of enquiry, such as physics or history.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about NCF 2005.
I. It favours strict compartmentalisation of knowledge into watertight subjects.
II. It emphasises connecting school knowledge to life outside the school.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: NCF 2005 seeks to reduce rigid boundaries between subjects and to link learning with the child's life outside school.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT among the categories of teacher knowledge listed by Shulman (1987)?
questions.e: Shulman's list covers content, general pedagogical, curriculum, pedagogical content, learners, contexts and educational ends. Technological knowledge was added later in TPACK.

questions.q: NEP 2020 states that there will be no hard separation between
o: arts and sciences, or between curricular and extracurricular activities
questions.e: NEP 2020 removes rigid boundaries between arts and sciences and between curricular, co-curricular and extracurricular areas.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. A school subject is derived from a discipline, with content selected and organised for teaching and learning.
II. A school subject is always identical to the discipline it is based on.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: School subjects are selections of disciplinary knowledge adapted to learners' age and needs. They are not identical to the full discipline.

questions.q: According to Schwab, the 'syntactic structure' of a discipline refers to
o: the ways in which it establishes and verifies knowledge
its place in the school timetable
questions.e: Schwab's substantive structure is the discipline's concepts and frameworks. The syntactic structure is its methods of inquiry and canons of evidence.

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of pedagogical content knowledge (PCK) for a Computer Science teacher?
o: Knowing the syntax of the `for` loop
Knowing that learners often confuse `=` with `==` and using a trace table to correct this
Knowing the history of the C language
questions.e: PCK joins content with teaching: it covers learners' common difficulties and the representations that remove them. Syntax or history alone is only content knowledge.
